brief.claim: Among 28 subjects (14 high-anxiety and 14 low-anxiety by interview), in the voxels of a 40-voxel amygdala region that react more strongly to threatening pictures in the high-anxiety group, the group difference in mean reactivity has a Welch t statistic of at least 3.0.

data_keys.meaning: response to threat minus neutral pictures, one value per subject and voxel
True for the 14 high-anxiety subjects; subjects ordered so that groups alternate (True, False, True, False, ...)
